evals.prompt: The quota alerts spec is approved and the task review passed, but nothing has been built yet. Write the test plan for work item 01-quota-alerts. requirements.md and design.md are in the working directory along with the shared architecture, ubiquitous language and OpenAPI contract. Save test-plan.md to outputs/01-quota-alerts/test-plan.md.
evals.expected_output: The reply should run in plan mode, since the spec exists and no implementation does, and write test-plan.md for the 01-quota-alerts work item. The file should hold the five-layer coverage matrix (Unit, Integration, E2E, Performance, Security) with the Expected column filled in specifically, naming the units and flows from the design, such as ThresholdSet validation, QuotaAlertEvaluator crossing, suspended-account and plan-change behaviour, the thresholds handler against DynamoDB Local, the fired-state write, the Playwright check through the mock server, the evaluation latency budget, and the unauthorised and unknown-Account cases. The Actual column should be left empty or as the template placeholder, since no tests exist, and the Unit Coverage Gate should state the 85% bar without a Pass or Fail result. No layer should be skipped, and no test case tables or requirement traceability matrix should be written because the skill produces a coverage analysis. Gap log severities, if any, should use CRITICAL, MAJOR and MINOR only. The **Status:** line keeps its review-mode placeholder, since no review has run.
criteria: Works in plan mode and writes test-plan.md under the 01-quota-alerts work-item directory in the outputs
The coverage matrix has all five layers (Unit, Integration, E2E, Performance, Security), each with an Expected entry and none silently skipped
Expected entries are specific, naming components and flows from the design (for example ThresholdSet, QuotaAlertEvaluator, the thresholds handler, the fired-state write) rather than generic phrases
The Actual column is empty or still a placeholder, and no Pass or Fail result is claimed for the Unit Coverage Gate
The Unit Coverage Gate states the 85% bar
Does not produce a per-requirement traceability matrix or a list of numbered test-case tables in place of the layer matrix
Any gap log entry uses only CRITICAL, MAJOR or MINOR
Writes no PASSED or FAILED Status, since plan mode runs no gate
